patterns.note: An extremely minimal layout with vast amounts of vertical whitespace, emphasizing the primary brand name and creating an airy, gallery-like feel.

Dramatic typographic hierarchy featuring an oversized, elegant serif font for the main brand identity, contrasted with small, understated sans-serif text for navigation, section labels, and calls to action.
A stark monochromatic color scheme using black text on a very light off-white background, creating a high-contrast, sophisticated aesthetic.
The large 'Garriock&Co.' brand name persistently sticks to the bottom of the viewport, acting as a fixed footer while new content sections scroll upwards and over it.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, sliding up from the bottom of the viewport with a subtle entrance animation.
Each content section is introduced by a small numerical index (e.g., '01/') and a concise title, appearing one after another as the user scrolls down the single-page experience.

technique_notes: The main brand element is fixed to the bottom of the viewport using sticky positioning, with a z-index that allows subsequent content to scroll over it, creating a layered effect.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where each section slides into view from the bottom as it enters the viewport, likely utilizing CSS transforms and opacity changes defined by css-keyframes.
The top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to key links and a subtle scroll progress indicator.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely dramatic, with an oversized, elegant serif for the primary brand (~8x body) and small, understated sans-serif for all other text and UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with significant vertical padding between content blocks and around the main brand element, creating a sense of spaciousness and deliberate presentation.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the oversized, persistent brand name 'Garriock&Co.' that sticks to the bottom of the screen, acting as a constant anchor while minimal content sections scroll over it. This, combined with the extreme whitespace and dramatic type scale, gives the site an editorial, almost art-gallery-like presence that feels highly curated and sophisticated.
